stages.title: Passage contract
stages.body: Use only the text and the exact stem.

stages.title: Stem taxonomy
stages.body: Classify detail, main idea, inference, assumption, tone or statement-set.

stages.title: Claim map
stages.body: Separate claim, reason, example, qualifier and contrast.

stages.title: Central idea
stages.body: Cover the whole passage without importing a policy leap.

stages.title: Inference
stages.body: Choose the least extended conclusion licensed by the words.

stages.title: Assumption
stages.body: Negate the hidden bridge and test whether the argument collapses.

stages.title: Tone and purpose
stages.body: Read attitude from wording, not from subject matter.

stages.title: Quantifiers
stages.body: Preserve some, many, can, must, only, unless and necessary/sufficient.

stages.title: Distractors
stages.body: Reject scope creep, reversal, half-truth and outside knowledge.

stages.title: Paired passages
stages.body: Map each claim to passage 1, passage 2, both or neither.

stages.title: Timed execution
stages.body: Predict, match, eliminate, discriminate and park at the ceiling.

stages.title: Audit and retry
stages.body: Quote the supporting phrase and code every miss before retry.
